newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil council to OK Banerj selloff - paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil council to OK Banerj selloff - paper.

text.p: Brazil's National Monetary Council (CMN) is due to give today the green light for the beginning of the selloff of Rio de Janeiro state bank Banerj, Jornal do Brasil daily said.
Banerj has been managed since early January by private bank Bozano, Simonsen, hired to restructure the bank and ready it for privatization.
Jornal do Brasil said Rio de Janeiro state government plans to sell the bank before the end of the year.
"If everything goes well, the auction is likely to be set for November," Rio Planning Secretary Marco Aurelio Alencar was quoted as saying.
The CMN also might discuss changes in Brazil's Reference Rate (TR) in a move to boost savings accounts and rules for pension funds investments, private InvestNews agency said.
